description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API using the jurebes 'skipgram_logreg' baseline: skip-gram word featurizer + Logistic Regression.
notes: Same engine as every other jurebes fighter, different featurizer x classifier recipe (registry baseline 'skipgram_logreg', group(s): linear); single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate. The arena measures which sklearn recipe wins on assistant-style templates, not which fighter 'is' jurebes.
